title: WP-IMP-A: freeze badf-implementation-plan (G06 planning composition/router; DESIGNED)
objective: Freeze the badf-implementation-plan capability contract as DESIGNED: a thin G06 planning composition/router that turns an approved G01-G05 design into a governed Work Package DAG and normalizes it into the EXISTING G06 evidence (work-breakdown/test-plan/release-plan/rollback-plan). Root SKILL.md + 16 references + IMP-I01..I17. Freezes the doctrine Task != Work Package != GitHub Issue != Branch and Implementation Plan != Authority. Composes G06's existing four artifacts (no fifth gate artifact, no lifecycle change); authority DERIVED from change_class C0-C3 (no A0/A2 system); DECLARES execution topology while badf-git REALIZES it; NO scripts/badf_implementation_plan.py, NO schema, NO execution engine; does not duplicate G01-G05.
business_value: G06 has a gate and four artifacts but no capability to author them coherently from an approved design. A DESIGNED contract freeze fixes the ownership boundaries first -- the plan composes the existing G06 evidence, derives authority from change_class rather than inventing one, declares topology while badf-git realizes it -- so the later IMPLEMENTED/VALIDATED/SHADOWED/ACTIVE WPs build on a stable contract. It is the point where BADF stops thinking in tasks and produces bounded, governable execution units.
